llm.summary: This is a coherent AI-news digest skill that fetches public news and writes local Markdown reports, with a notable but manageable install-script supply-chain risk.

dimensions.detail: The requested WebFetch/WebSearch, limited Read, Write, and simple Bash date/mkdir/ls capabilities fit the stated purpose of generating a local Chinese AI-news digest.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The README and skill body disclose the output path, same-day update modes, local archive behavior, and source-fetching workflow; the trigger phrases are broad, so users should invoke it deliberately.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The README recommends curl-to-bash and PowerShell iex install commands, and the included installers fetch SKILL.md from GitHub main without pinning checksums or a release artifact. The scripts themselves are simple installers, but this pattern carries normal supply-chain risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access is aimed at public AI news sources, and local file access is scoped to the digest output directory or a user-supplied path rather than credentials, profiles, or broad local indexing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persists generated reports under ~/Desktop/ai-news and may archive/replace same-day reports in update mode; it does not create background services, request privilege escalation, or access secrets.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a local agent-generated Chinese AI news digest. Prefer the manual or ClawHub install path, or download and inspect the installer before running it, because the one-line install commands execute remote code. Use explicit path and mode parameters if you want tighter control over where files are written or whether same-day reports are archived and updated.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The pipe-to-shell and PowerShell iex install instructions are a real supply-chain concern, but they are disclosed installation paths rather than hidden runtime behavior, and the included scripts only create the skill directory and download SKILL.md.
